pairs.subject: voice-interview-fidelity
pairs.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/eval/voice/wer.py:246 The entity gate counts only spoken-but-unheard terms (recall); it never computes the terms the transcript holds that were never spoken. Meanwhile the same harness turns on per-job ASR keyword biasing (el_ws.py:82) and runs no null-audio control, so a boosted phantom skill passes every gate.

techniques.evidence: pipeline/jobfit/eval/voice/wer.py:246 Only ref−hyp is computed; there is no hyp−ref phantom list. Searching eval/voice for phantom/null-audio/precision finds nothing, although asr.keywords biasing is sent (el_ws.py:82).

pipeline/jobfit/eval/voice/wer.py:239 Gate on a restricted tech lexicon with a zero deletion budget. Matching is by stem with a bounded inflection allowance (_MAX_INFLECTION=3), longest term first, and short ambiguous names are excluded. session_runner.voice_checks fails on any missing term separately from aggregate WER.
pipeline/jobfit/eval/voice/tts.py:28 One synthetic Piper speaker per language (en, cs), so fidelity is never stratified by accent or first language. The accent matrix is admitted as future work.

pipeline/jobfit/eval/voice/el_ws.py:78 The scenario language is sent into the realtime speech configuration override, not only into the prompt, mirroring production. Per-turn drift detection is not in this context's files (it lives in interview_eval).
